_comment: The live-search PROBE SET (post-test Phase 7). Our own wording, never dataset text, so it is committed. A demo set, not a benchmark: ~40 claims cannot support a metric, and results are reported claim by claim. Labels were drafted by the assistant and APPROVED BY THE PROJECT OWNER before any run (docs/live-search-probe.md). label: true | false | unverifiable (nothing public settles it; the right answer is 'nothing found' / not confident, never a confident verdict). style: en | hi-deva | hi-latn | pa-guru | pa-latn.
